Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism
Join molecule_dictionary parent on parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL95'
Join molecule_hierarchy mh on mh.parent_molregno = parent.molregno
Join molecule_dictionary child on child.molregno = mh.molregno
Join compound_records r on r.molregno = child.molregno
Join docs d on d.doc_id = r.doc_id
Join activities a on a.record_id = r.record_id
Join assays ass on ass.assay_id = a.assay_id
Join target_dictionary t on t.tid = a.tid
Join compound_structures cs on cs.molregno = child.molregno
Filter a.standard_type = 'IC50' and a.bao_endpoint = 'BAO_0000190' and a.standard_units = 'nM' and t.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL220'
Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism
Sort by compound_chembl_id, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism
